name: Oakley Flight Deck XM / M snow goggles
summary: Medium snow goggles with a documented Matte Black / Prizm Snow Sapphire Iridium option. The lens is intended for sun and clouds, not every blizzard or low-light situation.
description: The manufacturer identifies this option as OO7064-41-0, size M. Ridgelock supports lens changes, while the double lens has an F3 anti-fog coating. Anti-fog treatment does not guarantee clear vision in every condition. The owner-supplied Amazon screenshot documents the matching Medium, Matte Black / Sapphire Iridium configuration.
